lines.en: I walk with a sack of powder on my shoulder
My beard is grey with soot
I go around the fire step by step

lines.zh: 我去看看仓库还剩什么
lines.en: I go see what's left in the store
My boots land hard
I pause at the doorway
I shift the sack to the other shoulder
I walk along the gallery
I glance up at the roof
I count the steps at the stair
I head for the workbench
I think through a recipe as I walk
I crouch at a crate and rummage
I straighten a fuse
Two gunpowder for one iron.

lines.zh: 我在看火, 不是发呆
lines.en: I'm watching the fire, not daydreaming
I line up the charges

lines.zh: 手里这根雷管，还没插引线。
lines.en: This stick of dynamite still needs its fuse.
This house still needs a corner
I rub my chin
The sky outside is decent
I count the stock
I hang the tools back on the wall

lines.zh: 我坐着，脚还在地上打拍子
lines.en: I sit, my foot tapping the floor

lines.zh: 我闻着硝石的味道，很舒服
lines.en: I like the smell of saltpeter
This batch is good
I'm waiting for a buyer
I should close up early today
The chimney wants a good sweep
My trade isn't afraid of noise
You're standing too near the powder
I raise a hand for you to step back
What'll it be, then
I've powder, and fireworks
You don't look like a buyer
I live in this house alone
Don't step on that line there
The crate at your feet is off limits
I talk loud; pay it no mind
Are you carrying a flame
Customers sit to talk
Have some water before we talk
I step back with a hand at my waist
I swear under my breath
A tear in my apron
I grab a crate for cover
I cough twice; smoke in my throat
I steady myself on the bench

lines.zh: 医药费，从你的订单里扣。
lines.en: I'll deduct the medical bill from your next order.

lines.zh: 我把火把换到另一只手
lines.en: I switch the torch to my other hand
I look at the wound
I don't retreat outside
Powder? I'm short of it
This batch is decent
Two more sacks would be better
I can use iron ingots too
Put it on the table
I can afford that price
This sack's a bit damp
Don't open it here
I'll throw something else in
Done; take it
You bump me and the sack nearly falls
I catch the crate and steady myself
My tools scatter
You squeeze past my shoulder

lines.zh: 我们撞在门口，都进不来
lines.en: We jam in the doorway together
I step back and clear the door
That knocked my back
I gather the fallen things
You stepped on my fuse
Careful; that sack can't be crushed
There's another figure in the house
She's weighing powder too

lines.zh: 我们把两张桌子并在一起
lines.en: We push our tables together
Her fuses are more even than mine
We count the crates together
She slides a bottle over
We sit in the doorway and smoke
This house fits two just right
She says the house needs another chimney
I say the floor needs reinforcing first
I heft it and guess the weight
This sack is too heavy
I put it on the shelf
I check the seal
This one's damp
I put it in the chest
I count and one slot's short
This must stay away from flame
I put it outside the door
I've written it in the ledger
Someone's at my crates
Hold the blast; let me measure the charge first.
I stand and the chair scrapes

lines.zh: 我在屋里，跑不掉的是你
lines.en: I'm in here, and you're the one cornered
The powder's here and I'm not afraid to light it
You raised a hand first
I snatch up a torch

lines.zh: 这一屋子都是我的东西
lines.en: Everything in here is mine
I wind a fuse around my hand
Don't think I only trade
Everyone in this trade has a temper
If you want trouble, I'll oblige
I raise the torch
A fuse turns between my fingers
Stay away from those sacks

lines.zh: 我这行的经验都在手上
lines.en: My experience is all in my hands
You've backed to the doorway; good
I close in, one step at a time

lines.zh: 地上的火药线你踩断了两根
lines.en: You've broken two powder trails
I sit back down in the chair
I know this house well
I hear everything you do
Don't touch that switch

lines.zh: 你要真想要, 我送你一箱
lines.en: If you really want it, I'll give you a crate
I swing what's in my hand
The smell of gunpowder arrives before my fist.
I shoulder you away
You back to the wall and I stop

lines.zh: 我把火把往你那边一送
lines.en: I thrust the torch your way

lines.zh: 你跳开了，火星落了一地
lines.en: You leap clear; sparks scatter

lines.zh: 这一下砸空了，箱子凹了
lines.en: I miss and dent a crate
I grab a fistful of your sleeve
You tear free and I hit the table
I'm not weak
The lamp in the house flickers on

lines.zh: 我从工作台后面站起来
lines.en: I rise from behind the workbench
Smoke comes from the chimney

lines.zh: 门口挂着牌子，写着爆破
lines.en: There's a sign at the door: Demolition
I tie my apron

lines.zh: 地上的箱子堆得比我高
lines.en: The crates stack higher than me
I clap the soot off my hands

lines.zh: 这屋子是我一块块搭的
lines.en: I built this house piece by piece
A customer; let me mind the fire first
I pull out a chair
I roll the shutter up
The smell of powder comes out of the house
I'm on fire; I roll, then slap it out

lines.zh: 我从梯子上摔下来，砸翻一堆箱子
lines.en: I fall off the ladder into the crates

lines.zh: 水灌进我嘴里，我呛得说不出话
lines.en: Water fills my mouth and I can't speak

lines.zh: 自己家的东西炸了，我耳朵嗡嗡响
lines.en: My own stock went off and my ears ring
An arrow pins my apron

lines.zh: 那股力量让我手里的引线熄了
lines.en: That force snuffs the fuse in my hand

lines.zh: 我忙了一整天没吃东西
lines.en: I worked all day without eating

lines.zh: 雷劈在屋顶上，整屋都在响
lines.en: Lightning hits the roof and the house rings

lines.zh: 脚下木板一空，我直往下掉
lines.en: The boards give and down I go
